resources.string: Distribute plot centres on an adjustable hexagonal grid.
1 ha per centre means approximately one centre per hectare. This grid does not define the area actually sampled.
From 0 to less than 360°. The grid is anchored at the centre of the map extent.
Angle from 0 to less than 360° in the local map plane.
Enter a positive radius or an area from 1 to 1,000,000 m².
Target area %1$s m² · side length %2$s m
Keep only footprints lying entirely inside the parcel. This exclusion changes the distribution and must suit the sampling protocol.
Check the distribution before creating plots. You can remove a centre. No survey is saved until you confirm.
Approximate distance between neighbouring centres: %1$s m
%1$d boundary plot(s) excluded from this plan.
%1$d footprint(s) touch a parcel boundary or an excluded area. The displayed area is the target area; no effective area or extrapolation is inferred.
Centres planned on the map are distinct from measured GPS positions. Areas are horizontal and distances approximate; adapt the protocol to the terrain and survey objectives.
This extent or these settings cannot produce a local grid. Use manual points or a parcel spanning less than 50 km.
No centres retained. Reduce the area per centre, change the orientation or adjust boundary exclusion.
